findings.detail: Titan BW Borrower L.P. first lien term loan source states S + 5.38% including 2.88% PIK, but the extracted holding has blank interest_rate instead of an all-in rate.

rationale: A07 uses the PIK all-in convention: interest_rate should carry the all-in stated coupon when a PIK leg is present. The raw SOI row for Titan BW Borrower L.P. states S + 5.38% and explicitly includes 2.88% PIK, while the bundle's extracted holding for the same issuer/instrument has blank interest_rate. This is a grounded extraction gap, not a false alarm.
